name: Maryland

teen.supervisedHours: 60 hours, including 10 at night (30 minutes before sunset to 30 minutes after sunrise); 14 hours including 3 at night for applicants 25 or older (manual p10)
teen.holdPermit: 9 months under 18; 3 months at 18 with diploma/GED or 19-24; 45 days at 25+. A moving violation, PBJ or suspension: at least 9 months from the most recent conviction/PBJ (manual p10).
teen.nightLimit: Provisional under 18: no unsupervised driving 12 midnight to 5 a.m., except to/from/during a job, organized volunteer program, official school activity, or athletic event/training (manual p47)
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional under 18: first 151 days no passengers under 18 other than immediate family, unless a qualified supervising driver is present (manual p47)
teen.phone: Learner's permit and provisional under 18: no wireless device, hands-free included, except 911 (manual p35, p47). All drivers: no hand-held phone use or texting (manual p35).

bac.under21: Any alcohol (zero tolerance): Transportation Art. 16-113(b) alcohol restriction on every licensee under 21; manual p33 says under 21 may not drink any alcohol

notes: Handbook: Maryland Driver's Manual DL-002, October 2025 Edition (footer DL-002 (10-25)); PDF created 2026-03-03, listed on the MVA manuals page as December 1, 2025. PDF page numbers equal printed page numbers.
Knowledge test: 25 questions, 20 minutes (manual p7); pass 88% = 22 of 25 (MVA knowledge-tests page, not in the manual).
Test languages from the MVA knowledge-tests page; spoken-language interpreters allowed (manual p12: if the test exists in your language you must take it 5 times before using an interpreter).
Supervising driver: at least 21, licensed at least 3 years for the same class, seated beside the learner (manual p51); MVA learner's permit page adds no other front-seat passengers.
Driver education: 30 hours classroom and 6 hours behind the wheel (MVA driver's education page; not in the manual).
Permit (Type 1) is valid up to 2 years (manual p9). Provisional license held at least 18 months before full license (manual p10-11).
Move Over (manual p45): any stopped, standing or parked vehicle with lights flashing; statute Transp. 21-405(e) lists hazard lights, road flares, cones and caution signs.
School bus (manual p38-39): stop at least 20 feet away; on a multi-lane road divided by a physical barrier, traffic on the other side does not stop.
Earlier draft said under-21 BAC 0.02 (secondary source); Maryland law is any alcohol (Transp. 16-113(b)). Corrected 2026-10-09.
